questions.quote: A circle which has 360° is divided into different sectors. The proportional values of various components should be converted into degrees.

en.q:
Assertion [A]: To draw a pie diagram, the values of the components must be converted into degrees.
Reason [R]: A circle has 360°, which is divided among the sectors in proportion to the components.
options: Both [A] and [R] are true and [R] is the correct explanation of [A]
Both [A] and [R] are true but [R] is not the correct explanation of [A]
en.explanation: Both are true; the 360° of the circle is shared among the components in proportion, which is why values are converted into degrees.
